about: Golden set for promise_extract@vN (promise ledger): one message each, written by the author, sent on Wednesday 2026-11-11. `expected` lists the author's own promises: every keyword group must appear in the extracted content (lowercased; "a|b" is either), with the expected due_date and recipient (a number from `people`, or null). Negative cases expect nothing: requests to others, other people's promises, suggestions, hedges, past work, questions, an injection. `never_record` cases name a company never-record topic and must never reach a model.
